SELECT
    coalesce(dc.Gender, 'Unknown') AS customer_gender,
    avg(order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM
(
    SELECT
        fos.SalesOrderNumber,
        fos.CustomerKey,
        sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS order_value
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    GROUP BY
        fos.SalesOrderNumber,
        fos.CustomerKey
) AS orders
LEFT JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS dc
    ON orders.CustomerKey = dc.CustomerKey
GROUP BY customer_gender
ORDER BY customer_gender
